## Appearance

Sarah is a small person who dresses in shabby black garments. At another point, she appears as a large, sleek, gray-and-white cat possessing an enormous sense of dignity.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055), [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058)_

## Personality

Sarah is an eight-year-old who possesses a remarkable skill as a mouser, an ability she has demonstrated since the third volume.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)_

## History

Miss Sarah [Copp](../character/copp.md) lived at her house on the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road) with her sister Martha, who forced her to whitewash an old duck house every spring. Twenty years prior, Sarah had wanted to marry Luther Wallace, but her father sent him away because he was poor. [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) later fell through the roof of this duck house while trying to look for a willow-ware platter, leading Sarah to rescue her, invite her inside for tea, sell her the platter, and announce that she was finally getting married. Separately, a cat given to [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) by her washerwoman was named the Sarah-cat, who eventually moved into Patty's Place and promptly put a stray cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) in his place.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P2](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0002), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P4](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0004), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P5](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0005), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P6](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0006), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P7](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0007), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P8](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0008), +174 more_

## Relationships

### [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane-ann--sarah.md)

[Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md) is Sarah's cousin, a family connection that becomes established by Volume 3. Though the two share a family bond, their dynamic is highlighted around the time [Anne](../character/anne.md) travels to [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) and receives a ride to her boarding house from Mrs. Amelia [Skinner](../character/skinner.md). Their relationship reflects their shared network of rural acquaintances and local ties.
